identity: The raw GeoJSON has no stable per-feature publisher IDs. Derived IDs qualify zero-based raw feature rows by dataset and pinned release. They are display IDs, not cross-release physical entities.
transformation: Preserve every feature, coordinate and property; add release-local display IDs, omit legacy top-level crs/name metadata and recompute display bbox from actual coordinates. Raw bytes remain unchanged.
findings: The coastline publisher bbox carries finer precision than the rounded coordinates, including east 180.00000044181. Actual coordinates are within range; the derived bbox uses those actual coordinates.
One coastline feature has publisher featurecla=Country. It is retained as publisher metadata and does not create a political or analytical boundary assertion.
limitations: Generalized 1:110m locator geometry; not navigation or surveyed detail.
Coordinate/ring checks do not prove topology, world accuracy or completeness.
No legal/administrative membership, geocoding, incident association or evidence support may use this display asset.
Release date is known; per-feature real-world observation dates are not supplied.
